name: Chiin no Kyoushitsu ~Onna Kyoushi to Sono Musume ni XX Suru~
original_name: 恥淫ノ教室 ～女教師とその娘に××する～
source:
Ryou is the vice principal. He hates Yuna, an English teacher, since she is popular among the students and threatens his position. One day, he accidentally sees Suzune, Yuna's daughter, shoplifting and tells her, "If I tell what you've done to your mother, she'll be in trouble...." Suzune yields to his threat and accepts his order....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090317090244/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1010567]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
里尤是副校长。他讨厌英语老师尤娜，因为她在学生中很受欢迎，威胁到了他的地位。有一天，他无意中看到尤娜的女儿铃音在商店行窃，并对她说：“如果我告诉你对你母亲做了什么，她就会有麻烦……”铃音屈服于他的威胁并接受了他的命令……
